Index gives the elevation as 587 m (1926 ft)

evidence.supports: Index marks the location as not verified

notes_for_editor: Thin evidence: one Firelookout.ca index record is the only source with content. It has no build year, agency, height, status or history. The story is about 80 words, below the roughly 120 the guide gives for thin sources, because nothing more could be footnoted. Searches and reads checked the Ontario still-standing lists (GeoCities and forestrangers), the GeoCities Ontario tower history page, the Canadian lookouts index and the cached Ontario LIO layer; none mentions Donovon. The location is marked not verified, so the map point is approximate. The name and the unorganized-area label come only from the index. Worth a human pass or a local-history search before this page is published.
